verdict.summary: REQUEST CHANGES (1 BLOCKER + 1 unresolved v17 item + 2 minor polish items). Fix the Desktop Band 2 header collision (e.g., concise '● commits · ■ PRs (scaled)' strictly within the left column) and add the weight-segment legend to Desktop Band 1, and the set will be ready to approve.
